item.title: Kashiwajima Island: Coral Reefs and Clear Sea — Guide
item.description: Kashiwajima is a tiny island off the far southwestern coast of Kochi, famous for water of extraordinary clarity — so transparent that moored boats appear to hover above the seabed as if floating in air. Where the warm Kuroshio current meets cooler waters, an exceptional diversity of marine life gathers, and the island is ringed by coral reefs home to a huge variety of tropical and temperate fish. This makes it one of the best places in mainland Japan for snorkelling and diving, with easy access to vivid underwater scenery just offshore.
